posts.name: Elías Röthschild
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I’m looking for someone to do EVERYTHING for me. I don’t know anything about n8n.

I need you to get everything set up and working automatically.

What I want in the end:
I just upload a video to a Google Drive folder and it publishes automatically on my Instagram / Facebook / YouTube accounts.

What I need you to do (complete setup):

  1. Create the complete n8n workflow from scratch
  2. Set up the Google Drive trigger to monitor my folder
  3. Connect it to a Google Sheet where my captions are (file name = row)
  4. Configure publishing using the official Instagram, Facebook Page, and YouTube APIs
  5. Get it ready to scale to 100+ accounts by reading tokens from the Sheet
  6. Set up all connections, error handling, and Telegram notifications
  7. Deliver it tested and working. I just want to upload videos.

What I provide:

  • Drive access
  • The Sheet
  • Access to my n8n / Meta and Google developer accounts (you tell me what to create)

I don’t want a template, I want you to set it up and explain it to me in a 5-minute video on how to use it.

This first job is a test for $20 for 1-3 accounts. If you do it well, I’ll pay you for the full scale to 300 accounts.

If you can do the complete setup ready to use, message me on DM.

Thanks!

posts.name: Md Shamrat Hossain
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I can develop this complete system in n8n so you only have to worry about uploading videos to Google Drive.

To manage more than 100 accounts cleanly without API blocks or crashes, I’ll build a dynamic sequential loop engine. The workflow will read the copy and tokens (OAuth/Refresh) directly from your Google Sheet, process the videos using the official Meta and YouTube APIs, and send you error alerts or expired tokens straight to Telegram.

I’ll deliver the automation 100% ready to use, configure error handling, and we’ll test it together step by step.

When do you have availability for a brief call to review your server and API access?

Contact me at shamrat.r.h@gmail.com

posts.name: Raj Desai
posts.cooked:
Hi,

Yes, I can set this up for you end to end, and you won’t have to learn n8n at all. You’d just drop a video in the folder and that’s it.

The way I’d build it, n8n watches the Drive folder, finds the caption row by the file name, posts to Instagram, your Facebook Page and YouTube, and sends you a Telegram message with what went out and what failed.

Instagram can’t post straight from a Drive link, so the video gets put at a public link for a moment while Meta pulls it. Meta logins also expire after about 60 days, so I set up the refresh, otherwise it just stops posting one day and you don’t know why. And YouTube’s default API limit only covers a handful of uploads a day across all channels, which is fine for a few accounts but not for 300, so we’d ask Google for more before scaling.

For setup I’ll send you a short list of exactly what to create in Meta and Google, and you click Allow on each account. I’ll test it with a real video on your 1 to 3 accounts, then record the 5 minute video showing you how to use it.

Adding an account later will just be a new row in the Sheet. For the 300, are those all accounts you run yourself, or your clients’? because that changes what Meta needs to approve.

posts.cooked:

Is the complete $20 test mandatory, or is there a separately approved budget for the full rollout that can be scoped before a test? We cannot undertake the complete 1–3-account setup for $20.

If the $20 complete setup is mandatory, please treat us as not applying. Otherwise, could you share the full-rollout budget range and starting conditions? This is an enquiry, not acceptance of the test or a delivery commitment.

posts.name: Shital Katre
posts.cooked:
Hi Elias,

I can help build this in n8n, starting with a properly tested 1–3 account pilot before scaling further.

I’d structure the workflow around Google Drive uploads, filename-based Google Sheets lookups, official Meta and YouTube APIs, and Telegram notifications for failed uploads or authentication issues.

For the pilot, I’d first verify the account types, API permissions, OAuth setup, and video-publishing requirements. I’d also include duplicate-upload prevention, retry handling, execution logs, and a clear status in the Sheet so failed posts can be identified and retried safely.

Once the pilot is working reliably, we can evaluate the architecture and API limits before expanding to 100+ accounts.

Could you share your current n8n hosting setup and confirm whether your Instagram accounts are professional accounts linked to Facebook Pages? That will help define the pilot scope accurately.

posts.name: Shafique Mumtaz
posts.cooked:
Hi Elias — I build production n8n workflows, and this is exactly the kind of system I do. A few honest notes on the architecture before you hire anyone:

For 100+ accounts, the design matters more than the nodes: one parent workflow watching your Drive folder (trigger on new video), which fans out to per-account child workflows via Execute Sub-workflow. Each account gets its own credentials (Meta app per FB/IG account, YouTube OAuth per channel) — never share one credential across accounts or a single ban takes down everything.

Captions from the Sheet: match by filename, validate the row exists before publishing, and log every publish (account, video, timestamp, post ID) to a results sheet so you can audit all 300 later.

Stagger the publishing — don’t fire 100 posts at once or the platforms will rate-limit (or flag) you. A queue with randomized delays between posts per account keeps it looking natural.

Happy to do the $20 test for 1–3 accounts so you can see the build quality before committing to the full 300. What I need from you for the test: one Drive folder with a sample video, the caption sheet format, and the credentials for the test accounts.
— Shafique
